what: Turn the switch on and the pieces in the panel (icons · cards · open windows) become Matter bodies with corners rounded 15%, pour to the floor at gravity 1.4, bounce with restitution .35 · friction .1 and pile up, and can be picked up and thrown with the mouse (grab strength .2). Turn it off and the farther a piece has gone, the longer (1.25~2.25s) it takes, flying back with power4.out at .03s intervals to stick in its place at its own tilt

options.back-min: Time for the nearest piece to return (sec), default 1.25
options.back-max: Time for the farthest piece to return (sec), default 2.25
options.[data-fx-part=body]: Pieces that become objects. Exclude hidden ones (size 0, visibility hidden) and include only those visible when turned on
options.[data-fx-part=toggle]: Switch inside the panel (if any). Keeps aria-pressed in sync
options.fx:toggle·fx:on·fx:off: Event the switch outside the panel sends to this element
options.class fx-gravity: Sticks to the panel while on — use for switch shapes and turning off other Interaction responses

from.where: index.html menu bar gravity toggle (index.js gravity — icons and open windows spill down)

note: On phones (no hover) it only pours down and does not enable grab-and-throw, because Matter’s touch handle blocks page scroll. While it is on, pieces turn off pointer-events, so dragging or clicking a piece itself is left to the user, who should watch fx-gravity and stop.
